tasks.corrected_reference_answer: _filter_enum_dict walks nontrivial parents in MRO order, collects eligible names, and queries their actual value on enum_class (sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py:130-149). It excludes native Enum names unless a candidate was found in a mixin/data type (sphinx/ext/autodoc/importer.py:151-160). This preserves eligible mixin overrides for documentation; it does not alter Python's runtime MRO or prevent shadowing itself. Runtime lookup has already selected the value returned by attrgetter.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: These tests supply reStructuredText :param: and :type: fields directly to restructuredtext.parse, including list of str and str or float or int (tests/test_domains/test_domain_py_fields.py:395-405,441-451). PyXrefMixin.make_xrefs splits type targets by delimiter regex, preserves delimiters, and creates cross-references for type names (sphinx/domains/python/_object.py:110-139). The tests assert the resulting parameter/type node sequence and nesting (tests/test_domains/test_domain_py_fields.py:408-436). They validate Napoleon-style delimiter support in Python-domain fields, not a mandatory preceding Napoleon tokenizer execution.

checked_claims.reason: Lists are unhashable regardless of their elements; stored lists make current nested-name hash fail.

material_errors: Lists are unhashable regardless of their elements; stored lists make current nested-name hash fail.
tasks.notes: Static inspection of pinned source; no upstream code execution.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: ASTPostfixMemberOfPointer.__hash__ delegates to hash(self.name) (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:774-785). ASTNestedName stores names and templates as supplied lists and attempts hash((self.names, self.templates, self.rooted)) (sphinx/domains/cpp/_ast.py:217-237). With those ordinary lists, hashing raises TypeError even if every element is hashable. Thus the delegation exposes a real hashability limitation in this pin; defining __hash__ alone does not make these instances successfully hashable.
